articles.title: Google Will Now Tell You Exactly How Much It’s Crediting You For Invalid Traffic
articles.summary: Digital advertisers have always wondered exactly how much of their ad budgets they’re wasting on bots. Now, Google will tell them. Today, Google Ads announced it’s adding a new feature called the Invalid Traffic Overview...

articles.title: Yahoo becomes first licensee of ‘Spotify-like’ collective AI content licensing model
articles.summary: Yahoo is the first licensee of the Internet Licensing Collective, offering publishers a new way to get paid for content used in AI search.

articles.title: Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
articles.summary: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's AI Mode is getting better at understanding complex queries, surfacing relevant links, and delivering richer visual responses.
